sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: Look 2 still reads as smooth coated material with chalk-bright seam outlines, rather than the reference's worn black denim.
sequence_defects.evidence: S01@00:01.500 and S01@00:02.500 show broad smooth highlights and conspicuously pale stitching across the fronts and pocket edges.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Regenerate the material treatment against the denim reference while preserving the source performance.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: hardware proportions and exaggerated pocket-flap edging remain product-inaccurate. The macro emphasizes the mismatch rather than establishing garment authenticity.
sequence_defects.evidence: S01@00:03.500 shows large pale fasteners; S02@00:04.500 enlarges the outlined flaps and buttons; S04@00:12.500 retains conspicuous hardware.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Use one reference-matched hardware and pocket construction across performance renders and the macro.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: pre-hook cuts exchange jacket length, wear distribution and fastener treatment instead of maintaining one Look 2 garment.
sequence_defects.evidence: S01@00:03.500 has longer outlined fronts; S03@00:06.500 introduces a shorter, more washed body and cuffs; S04@00:12.500 changes the front hardware presentation again.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Propagate one approved jacket construction across cuts, accounting for pose and S04's crop.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: the lower fronts separate beneath the zipper and expose pale underlying material. This is a lower-closure failure, not permitted shirt-and-tie visibility at the neck.
sequence_defects.evidence: S08@00:27.500 shows a triangular opening below the closure; S08@00:28.500 exposes a pale strip between the lower fronts.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Restore the approved closed lower front and continuous zipper-to-hem construction.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT under the documented nonblocking styling exception: tie, shirt and cuff variants persist. Approved neck-layer visibility is not classified as an open-jacket defect.
sequence_defects.evidence: S06@00:17.500 uses a fine-striped tie; S09@00:30.500 has ribbed mastic cuffs; S11@00:35.500 displays broad white cuffs.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Retain the recorded exception; do not introduce an additional release block for these styling differences.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: unapproved body and pocket construction still prevents a consistent product realization. Accepted late-hook styling differences are not counted as an additional release block.
sequence_defects.evidence: S08@00:25.500 presents a long, comparatively flat front; S12@00:39.500 shows high angular pocket openings unlike the reference's lower slit-pocket construction.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Use the approved realization as the shared body and pocket anchor, preserving documented styling tolerances.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: the city insert still separates visibly different Look 1 jacket bodies rather than concealing a continuous garment realization.
sequence_defects.evidence: S06@00:21.500 has a short gathered body and broad flared collar; S08@00:24.500 returns with straighter elongated fronts and a much smaller upright collar.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Match S08's collar, body proportions and waistband to the approved hook anchor before propagation.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: waistband definition and lower-front geometry change across sampled arm-crossing and turning poses, independently of the remaining edge-mask damage.
sequence_defects.evidence: S08@00:25.500 has an irregular central termination; S08@00:26.500 develops unequal lower fronts; S08@00:27.500 restores a more defined band around an open central split.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Propagate a single pose-aware waistband and closure model throughout S08.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT within accepted late-hook tolerance: cross-cut garment variants remain visible but are not independently release-blocking.
sequence_defects.evidence: S09@00:30.500 has a continuous pale ribbed hem; S11@00:35.500 uses separated white waistband sections; S12@00:39.500 returns to a mastic waistband.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Track the variance without expanding the exception to cover defective band or matte integration.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: the wearer-right chest stripe loses sections to beige wedges instead of remaining a complete band that follows the garment.
sequence_defects.evidence: S11@00:35.500 shows a rectangular stripe segment; S11@00:36.500 introduces a diagonal beige interruption; S11@00:37.500 leaves the wearer-right segment visibly truncated.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Track a complete stripe through garment deformation and preserve its continuity under folds.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: the replacement band reads as a graphic overlay, with hard patch boundaries and implausible integration around the neck-layer opening.
sequence_defects.evidence: S11@00:33.500 exposes an abrupt horizontal patch around the tie opening; S11@00:35.500 shows squared ends and mismatched stripe levels beside the neck layer.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Rebuild garment-surface warping, shading and neck-layer occlusion; do not solve this by enlarging the stripe.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: smoothing has not produced a consistently finished fabric boundary. Angular bites and pale remnants remain along the repaired lower edge.
sequence_defects.evidence: S08@00:25.500 retains pale central fringe; S08@00:26.500 has an abrupt lower-edge step; S08@00:28.500 shows a notched edge and pale residue near the split.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Reconstruct the fabric silhouette and underlying occlusion rather than applying further edge smoothing alone.

sequence_defects.description: PRESENT: the moving wearer-right shoulder/upper-arm silhouette remains eroded into a stepped cutout.
sequence_defects.evidence: S06@00:21.500 shows a squared recess on the screen-left upper arm above the raised hand. S06@00:20.500 supplies the preceding extended-arm contour.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Recover the missing sleeve silhouette from the source-aligned garment render and rebuild the motion-aware alpha.

sequence_defects.description: NEW: regenerated S06 satisfies the mastic exterior but exposes tan inward-facing collar surfaces instead of the required navy interior.
sequence_defects.evidence: S06@00:17.500 and S06@00:18.500 show broad tan inner collar faces with dark edging only; S09@00:30.500 provides a visibly dark interior comparison.
sequence_defects.recommended_action: Constrain the collar's separate inner and outer surfaces: navy inward, mastic outward, retaining approved neck styling.
